backend/main.mo: Motoko backend with role-based access control, user signup flows, admin allowlist logic, and CRUD state maps for users and daily service reports.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented PWA, Android TWA, and icon-related changes with associated files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing frontend files including hooks, components, pages, styling, and deployment docs.
frontend/ANDROID_TWA_BUILD.md: Guide explaining how to package the web app into an Android TWA using Bubblewrap or manual Android Studio setup.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment instructions for running the app on the Internet Computer, covering local development, mainnet deployment, upgrades, and validation checks.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global CSS defining OKLCH color tokens and light/dark theme variables for the UI.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry file loading the React frontend with PWA manifest, icons, and theme metadata.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app metadata, theme colors, start URL, and Android app icons for installation.
frontend/public/sw.js: Implements a service worker with precaching, cache cleanup, and network-first or cache-first fetch strategies for offline support.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines the root app logic handling authentication, profile loading, error states, and route rendering.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: Displays an access denied message for non-admin users with a button to return home.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Renders the app header with navigation, user ID display, copy functionality, and logout actions.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Provides the page layout including header, footer, offline banner, and main content area.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Shows login and signup options using Internet Identity with handling for stale sessions.
frontend/src/components/OfflineBanner.ts: Shows an alert banner when the user is offline.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Handles new user profile creation with validation and separate signup flows for engineers and admins.
frontend/src/components/SessionInvalidSc: Shows an error screen for invalid or expired sessions with an option to fully log out.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFullLogout.ts: Provides a full logout flow clearing identity, auth storage, React Query cache, and reloading the page.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity context, handling auth client creation, login, logout, and identity state management.
frontend/src/hooks/useNetworkStatus.ts: Tracks online/offline network status using browser events.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching profiles, admin checks, and performing signup and related mutations via the actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind-based global stylesheet defining light/dark themes and custom color variables.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point setting up React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering the app.
frontend/src/pages/AdminUsersPage.tsx: Admin interface for listing, deleting users, purging legacy data, and resetting the system with access control checks.
frontend/src/pages/ReportDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed information for a service report, with loading and error handling and navigation back to history.
frontend/src/pages/ReportEntryPage.tsx: Form page for creating service reports with validation and submission via useCreateReport.
frontend/src/pages/ReportHistoryPage.tsx: Displays and filters report history, supports CSV download and principal-based filtering.
frontend/src/utils/authErrorDetection.ts: Detects whether errors indicate missing profiles or genuine authentication failures.
frontend/src/utils/authSessionCleanup.ts: Clears Internet Identity-related localStorage and sessionStorage keys for logout cleanup.
frontend/src/utils/copyToClipboard.ts: Utility to copy text to the clipboard with a fallback method for older browsers.
frontend/src/utils/formatPrincipal.ts: Formats principal IDs for display and returns full versions when needed.
frontend/src/utils/reportDownload.ts: Converts reports to CSV format and triggers file download with a generated filename.
Produces user-friendly signup error messages by sanitizing and interpreting backend errors.
frontend/src/utils/signupFlowDebug.ts: Provides sanitized error logging and debugging helpers for the signup/profile flow.
frontend/src/utils/signupValidation.ts: Provides validation functions for required fields, email format, and mobile number formatting and length.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Handles extracting, storing, retrieving, and clearing URL and session-based parameters, including hash routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, animations, container settings, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s state, existing features, Android-related requirements, and pending build request metadata.
